name: 课题申报书
description_zh: 为一线教师/教研员撰写教育科研课题申报书：从选题诊断到八章撰写（背景/概念/目标/内容/方法/计划/成果/团队/经费），覆盖校到省级以上各级别。触发关键词：课题申报书、课题立项、教育科研课题、教师课题、项目申报书。
description_en: Writes educational-research project proposals for frontline teachers / teaching researchers: from topic diagnosis to eight-section writing (background / concepts / objectives / content / methods / plan / outcomes / team / budget), covering levels from school to provincial-and-above. Trigger keywords: research proposal, project approval, educational research project, teacher project, grant application.
